definitions.explanation: The vehicles and systems—trucks, ships, trains, planes—used to move goods or people from one place to another.

examples.japanese: {輸送機関|ゆそうきかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まる→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: Transport services come to a halt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{輸送機関|ゆそうきかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Moving a large amount of cargo requires a transport system.

examples.japanese: ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{輸送機関|ゆそうきかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乱|みだ}れて→乱れる：09506_midareru⟧、⟦{物資|ぶっし}→物資：07863_busshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}き→届く：00899_todoku⟧にくく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: During a disaster, transport systems are disrupted and supplies become hard to deliver.

notes:
Written ⟦{輸送|ゆそう}→輸送：04084_yusou⟧ (transportation of goods) + ⟦{機関|きかん}→機関：02630_kikan⟧ (engine; organ; system). Tends to emphasize moving cargo and freight.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{交通機関|こうつうきかん}→交通機関：21264_koutsuukikan⟧: means of transportation — emphasizes moving people (trains, buses) rather than goods
- ⟦{輸送|ゆそう}→輸送：04084_yusou⟧: transport, conveyance — the act of transporting, not the system itself
